title: Critique: "life is cognition" conflates cognition with adaptation

statements.text: Margaret Boden objects that equating life with cognition conflates cognition with adaptation, and that cognition should be used more strictly so that autopoiesis does not imply it. Thompson replies that adaptation is a background condition of all life while cognition is the sense-making that sustains it.

sources.quote: conflates cognition with adaptation. Margaret Boden (2000, p. 40) makes this charge.
